summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Front Door Media filmmaker portal and email notification system. All specified features are working correctly including portal lookup, submission display, QA reports, and email notifications for publish/reject actions.
passed_tests: GET /api/portal/lookup?email={email} - Returns submissions with QA summary for test@example.com
GET /api/portal/lookup?email={email} - Returns empty results for non-existent email
GET /api/portal/lookup - Returns 422 error when email parameter missing
GET /api/portal/submission/{id}?email={email} - Returns detailed submission with QA report
POST /api/submissions/{id}/publish - Successfully publishes and triggers email notification (202 status)
POST /api/submissions/{id}/reject - Successfully rejects and triggers email notification (202 status)
Frontend portal at /#portal - Loads correctly and email lookup form works
Frontend portal - Submission cards display with proper status badges and QA summaries
Frontend portal - View Full Report modal opens and displays detailed QA information
Admin dashboard - Filmmaker Portal button navigates correctly to portal
Portal accessible via both /#portal and /portal URLs
Email notifications working via SendGrid (confirmed in backend logs)
Portal shows 'No submissions found' message for empty results
QA summary displays technical checks with proper pass/fail indicators
Detailed modal shows issues, recommendations, and rejection reasons
